It is done, and submitted. You can play “Survival Legend” (for 1 player) … Well, kind of. It’s missing quite a few elements that will be added in the future.

For now:

* 1 save slot
* No achievements (No hard thing)
* Gamepads are not supported at all
* AI and Enemies aren’t yet implemented (Planned)
* …

Future:

* Multiple Difficulty Levels
* Some Event Sequence options
* …

If you want to help with some development:
Feel free to join my Developing Channel. You may be able to support with a donation, though that’s not necessary.

It is done, and submitted. You can play “Survival of the Fastest” against yourself in or against another player at https://www.1800clever.com/projects/survival-of-the-fastest. In effect, this will be a 2-player version of this game (one by one), though I leave a lot of room for improvisation on how to play if there’s not two players. However, don’t expect me to give some of that specific, I don’t trust much the potential of random to help the impression of playing with another. The top player will win. In that case, we will try to apply which type of player is the one that will be the favorite in this kind of game (since we are all three observing how the game ends like having the Three Wise Men as observers 🙂 ), so a question not answered in this version could be important for the other two players. If one or more of the three doesn’t answer, inmediately that the “result” isn’t known that will be taken as as the one that failed answering. I expect to reach as many trials or so as six when you can decide how many trials to do.

The picture shows the best 5 trials of three consecutive trials. Note that in the first trial, a 4th landed completely just beyond the “safe” zone, in this case, by mistake I could write that as an invalid attempt.

It is done, and submitted. You can play “Survivalist” on Twitch for this weekend. Today is: Feb 9th for me at 2am EST / 11pm PST to Feb 12/000am. If you’d like to play along with this event (or just to test it out) then here is the invite link to sign up for Survivor! * https://stream.twitch.tv/t/Survivorship It is upgraded this time around to 10 islands and we have more custom monsters than in previous twitch sessions. We will be starting on some new island layouts and we will use the new location in case you are interested in that sweet, sweet holo deck that is on the “Hidden” island type. To access we will have to go by using the new map, but I will cross that bridge when I get to it. We should be getting this to work for the Twitch preview map, and so I just need to tweak things a little so we will have some custom models (like the “new follow” group like we did previously). Hopefully I’ll finish this, tweaked, in time for Catskill Horror’s run, but I may not; so you can still join! I will be supporting the stream as best I can from the Discord chat and hopefully keep it as informative and as fun as possible.

STREAM TIMING

The start time will be 2000 on the 9th (Feb) and will last until all the chat islands (i.e., each season will take 3 hours to complete) complete at 200pm EST on the 12th.
